bio:
A tool for generating procedurally packed, seamlessly tiling textures for games: scatter circles under a packing rule, tune the radius range and density, and preview the result tiled in a live WebGL shader before you export it.

One page, no install. By Tront (Trent Sterling), a Unity generalist who builds the tools he needs.
title: Procedural Packed Texture Generator by Tront
list:
• VIXELS: Vector materials for voxel surfaces: contours in data textures evaluated in the shader, so you can zoom forever.
  • Volumetric Light Beam: Three.js port of the Half-Life 2 fake volumetric light trick.
  • Frame-Rate Independent Lerp: Why naive lerp smoothing breaks at different frame rates, and the fix.
